description: Records (spec/SPEC.md §7): each case gives a signed record, its preimage canonical string and digest, its signer, and the result of verifying it at several times. "invalid" holds records that fail the form and cap checks, which run before the signature. "rotations" holds pairs (prev, next) and the result of the rotation check. "parse" holds bytes (or bytes_hex) and the result of reading them as a record (§2.5, §7.1). "rotation_claims" holds a record and the result of checking the rotation it claims by a reader that holds no record of its rotated_from (§7.3).
suite_parameters: Ed25519 signatures; sealing with RFC 9180 base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) (kem 0x0020), HKDF-SHA256 (kdf 0x0001), AES-256-GCM (aead 0x0002)
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data, fixed by construction: seeds are one byte repeated 32 times, and the rest comes from a seeded xorshift128+. They are public; never let them protect anything real.
notes: A record is valid from iat - skew; an address record until iat + ttl, a key record until exp, at most iat + 86,400; an accept-from record does not expire, and its roots hold at most 1,024 entries.

The cases added on 2026-10-25 follow the earlier ones in each list: the 14 degenerate keys as a record key with R the identity and S = 0 and iat ground until k is 0 mod 8, R the identity with S = k·a under the org key, the roots cap, the key record of a day, "parse" and "rotation_claims". The key record case changed: its exp was iat + 30 days.
